budgets.name: initial-brotli-wasm
budgets.rationale: Keeps the text-only release payload within the measured transfer envelope.

budgets.name: initial-gzip-wasm
budgets.rationale: Catches transfer regressions for environments without Brotli.

budgets.name: retained-node-delta-after-10000
budgets.rationale: Large-list removal must release old Fiber/RenderNode state.

budgets.name: released-render-nodes
budgets.rationale: A released tree must not retain RenderNodes.

budgets.name: released-fibers
budgets.rationale: A released tree must not retain Fibers.

budgets.name: embedded-startup-time
budgets.rationale: The Embedded cold route must remain measurable within a bounded window.

budgets.name: embedded-local-update-errors
budgets.rationale: Local updates must publish a clean runtime snapshot.

budgets.name: embedded-local-update-dom-mutations
budgets.rationale: Repeated local updates must remain bounded.

budgets.name: embedded-local-update-layout-passes-skipped
budgets.rationale: A commit that changes nothing the CSS layout reads must not scan the page for semantic roots again.

budgets.name: embedded-presentation-unlaid-roots
budgets.rationale: CSS must lay out every semantic root a presentation opens: nothing else lays a root out.

budgets.name: embedded-scrolling-layout-passes
budgets.rationale: Scrolling must exercise the layout host.

budgets.name: embedded-presentation-errors
budgets.rationale: Repeated presentation cycles must not emit runtime errors.
